geometry_edits.rationale: Shift the dominant body toward a clearer section-driven mass so the building can read as a continuous capacity-bearing volume rather than a blunt object.
A folded section can better support neighborhood-living hierarchy and a more articulated upper profile.
Keep the section logic aligned with the long axis so the mass remains coherent in all views.

graph_edits.rationale: Convert the dominant mass from a blunt bent-bar into a more legible continuous bend that can support a better street-facing threshold and clearer upper hierarchy.
Reduce the bend intensity slightly to preserve a clean anchor while keeping the mass reading continuous and capacity-aware.
Introduce a small access-side notch to create a legible entry seam and public ground response at the frontage edge.
Align the notch with the program-frame access side so the new void responds directly to the verified frontage.
Keep the carve modest so it reads as an entry/public threshold rather than a destructive subtraction.
Provide enough width for a visible seam in the massing diagram without over-fragmenting the dominant body.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent mass in all four views, with a stable dominant body and a modestly chamfered/top-folded profile. It is not visually fragmented and the parcel containment appears intact. The main weakness is programmatic: the blue frontage edge is answered only weakly, with no convincing public void, undercut, or entry seam at the access side, so the ground relationship is more sealed than ideal for neighborhood living. The silhouette is coherent and not stair-cluttered, but the form remains close to a compact block rather than a clearly active street building. The references support a controlled prismatic mass and a grounded commercial threshold, but the candidate only partially translates that into a public-facing base response.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is much taller and more tower-like than the neighborhood-living brief; useful for silhouette control, not typology copying.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A compact mass can still read as a clear civic object when it has a stepped/tapered profile and a legible dominant volume.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office tower typology and skyline context are only loosely transferable; do not import the vertical emphasis.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A single strong mass can be subtly torqued or tapered to produce a coherent upper hierarchy.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is more consolidated and less transparent at the base; this reference is better for threshold logic than for silhouette.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A low street-building can gain program fit through an active ground edge and a simple attached vertical marker without losing clarity.

warnings: Frontage/access response is under-articulated relative to the verified road edge.
Void/public-space logic is minimal; the mass does not strongly carve a usable ground figure.
The form is coherent but still somewhat generic in neighborhood-living terms.
